chunks: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ibn Mahboub, from Abu Ayoub al-Khazzaz, from al-Halby, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

'In the Book of Ali (peace be upon him), he used to strike with the whip, and with half the whip, and with part of it regarding the Penalties (Hudud). And when a boy and a girl who had not yet reached maturity were brought to him, he would not invalidate a single Penalty from the Penalties of Allah, Mighty and Majestic.' It was said to him: 'And how did he strike?' He said: 'He would take the whip in his hand from its middle or from its third, then strike with it according to the measure of their ages, and he would not invalidate a single Penalty from the Penalties of Allah, Mighty and Majestic.'

key_terms.الْحُدُود: Penalties (Hudud), specific fixed punishments in Islamic jurisprudence

ai.seo_question: How are Islamic penalties applied to children who have reached maturity but are not yet adults?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi elucidates the jurisprudential principle that the Hadd penalties for minors who have reached the age of discretion (mumayyiz) are not nullified but are proportionally adjusted based on their physical stature. It highlights Imam Ali’s (peace be upon him) practical application of this rule, where the severity of the whipping was calibrated to the number of teeth the child possessed, reflecting a nuanced approach to justice in Shia legal tradition. This method underscores the balance between maintaining the integrity of divine penalties and accommodating the developmental stage of the offender.

en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ibn Mahboub, from Abu Ayoub Al Khazaz, from Al Halby, 
Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘In the Book of Aliasws, heasws used to strike with the whip, and by half the whip, and part of it regarding the Penalties. And when they came with a boy and girl who had yet to mature, heasws would not invalidate a single Penalty (Hadd) from the Penalties of Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic’. It was said to himasws: ‘And how did heasws used to whip?’ Heasws said: ‘Heasws used to take the whip with hisasws hands, from its middle or from its third, then strike with it upon the measurement of their respective ages, and heasws would not invalidate a single Penalty (Hadd) from the Penalties of Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic’.
